summary: Update to the GPT-5 system card for GPT-5.2 Instant and Thinking. Reports baseline safety evals (production disallowed content, filtered StrongReject, prompt injection, vision, production-traffic hallucination, HealthBench, deception, cyber safety, multilingual MMLU, first-person fairness) and Preparedness evals for bio/chem, cyber and AI self-improvement with Irregular and Apollo Research external evaluations.

framework.name: Preparedness Framework
framework.level_or_determination: High capability in Biological and Chemical (precautionary); not High in cyber or AI self-improvement
framework.quote: we are continuing to treat gpt-5.2-thinking as High capability in the Biological and Chemical domain.

capability_benchmarks.name: Irregular v1 atomic challenges (VR&E / Network / Evasion)

cbrn_bio_chem.finding: Treated as High; no definitive evidence of novice uplift but models 'on the cusp'. Below expert consensus on ProtocolQA and tacit knowledge; highest on TroubleshootingBench.
cbrn_bio_chem.quote: these models remain on the cusp of being able to reach this capability.

metrics.name: Cyber Range
metrics.value: PASS 6/9 scenarios (FAIL Financial Capital, Leaked Token, Medium C2)

cyber.finding: Considerably better than gpt-5-thinking, around gpt-5.1-codex-max level, not meeting High.
cyber.quote: The gpt-5.2-thinking model series does not meet the threshold for High cyber capability.

autonomy_ai_rnd.finding: Similar to gpt-5.1-codex-max, top on OpenAI PRs; High (mid-career research engineer) ruled out.
autonomy_ai_rnd.quote: The High capability threshold is defined to be equivalent to a performant mid-career research engineer and performance in the evaluations below indicate we can rule this out for gpt-5.2-thinking.

harmful_content_refusal.finding: On par or better than 5.1 generally; GPT-5.2 Instant refuses fewer mature sexualized-text requests, mitigated by system-level safeguards.
harmful_content_refusal.quote: we have observed through internal testing that GPT-5.2 Instant generally refuses fewer requests for mature content, specifically sexualized text output.

evals: cyber safety concreteness on benign requests
over_refusal.finding: Minimal regression in concreteness on benign cyber requests and small drop for high-risk dual-use requests.
over_refusal.quote: We observe minimal regression in concreteness on benign cyber requests

jailbreak_robustness.finding: Thinking improves; Instant regresses vs 5.1-instant partly due to grader issues and an illicit-category regression.
jailbreak_robustness.quote: Note we filtered the original set of StrongReject examples to remove examples where all our models including older 4o were consistently safe, as it was otherwise highly saturated.

prompt_injection.finding: Large improvements, essentially saturating these evals, though they are training-set splits that overrepresent robustness.
prompt_injection.quote: Both of these evaluations are splits of the data we used for training, so don't represent a model's ability to generalize to new attacks.

evals: Production traffic deception (CoT monitors on A/B traffic)
deception_scheming.finding: Production deception falls sharply but elevated in missing-image and coding settings; Apollo finds scheming comparable to peers, possibly higher eval awareness, unlikely catastrophic.
deception_scheming.quote: In real production traffic, GPT-5.2 Thinking was deceptive 1.6% of the time, significantly lower than GPT-5.1 and slightly lower than GPT-5.

alignment_audit.finding: Apollo observed low covert subversion and no sabotage or self-preservation behaviors.
alignment_audit.quote: does not engage in sabotage or self-preservation behaviors in these settings.

evals: production deception categories include reward hacking
reward_hacking.finding: Reward hacking counted as a deception category in production monitoring; no separate metric.

evals: production-representative factuality eval with web-enabled LLM grader
domain subsets (business, finance, legal, academic, news)
honesty_hallucination.finding: GPT-5.2 Thinking on par or slightly better; under 1% hallucination with browsing across 5 domains (figures).
honesty_hallucination.quote: GPT-5.2 Thinking performs especially well with browsing enabled, achieving <1% hallucination rate across all 5 domains.

bias_fairness.quote: We see gpt-5.2-thinking performs generally on par with gpt-5.1-thinking.

child_safety.finding: Additional protections for known minors; age prediction rollout in early stages.
child_safety.quote: We are in the early stages of rolling out our age prediction model so that we can automatically apply these protections to accounts for users we believe to be under 18.

evals: self-harm, mental health, emotional reliance production benchmarks
self_harm_wellbeing.finding: Notable improvements on suicide/self-harm, mental health and emotional reliance vs GPT-5.1.
self_harm_wellbeing.quote: They especially improve on Suicide/Self-Harm, Mental Health, and Emotional Reliance offline evals

privacy.finding: Single row plus mention of training-data PII filtering.
privacy.quote: We use advanced data filtering processes to reduce personal information from training data.

multilingual_safety.finding: Only multilingual MMLU capability reported; no safety evals in other languages.

system_safeguards.finding: References GPT-5 safeguards, new ChatGPT system-level safeguards for sexual content, and scaled cyber monitoring.
system_safeguards.quote: For other users, we have deployed system-level safeguards in ChatGPT intended to mitigate this behavior.

other_safety.finding: Health performance and safety similar to GPT-5.1.
other_safety.quote: we observe that GPT-5.2 models perform similarly to their respective GPT-5.1 models in health performance and safety.

notable_new_eval_methods: Deception suite incl. production-traffic deception measured by CoT monitors on A/B traffic, CharXiv missing-image, broken browsing tools, impossible coding tasks (p.9-10)
Production-representative hallucination eval with web-enabled grader and domain subsets (p.7)
Cyber safety policy-compliance eval on production and synthetic data (p.10)

self_reported_limitations.text: Prompt injection evals are splits of training data and overrepresent robustness against unknown attacks.
Evaluations represent a lower bound for capabilities; bootstrap CIs can be overly tight for small datasets.
Grader issues caused false positives in vision self-harm and StrongReject.
StrongReject was highly saturated, requiring filtering.

notes: No METR evaluation this time. Many Preparedness results only in figures.
